First, notice that both $x$ and $y$ appear in each equation, all the variables are on the left-hand side, and all the constants are on the right-hand side.

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-3x+4y=10 \\ 5x+2y=-7\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ -7\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ -7\end{aligned}].
$$
